Subject: 20% off Stormline Jackets — Limited Stock, Ends Sunday
Preview: Your next wet-weather trip just got cheaper. 20% off the Northbay Stormline Shell, while stock lasts.
Body: You've got a trip coming up. Maybe it's a ridge walk that'll turn grey by noon, or a multi-day where the rain isn't a surprise — it's just part of the itinerary.

The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is built for that kind of day.

3-layer laminate construction. 20,000mm waterproof rating — it handles sustained wet weather without soaking through. 20,000 g/m² breathability so you're not cooking inside your own jacket on the climb. Weighs 420g, so it earns its place in the pack without argument.

It's not an alpine mountaineering shell. It's not built for ice or extreme cold on its own. But for long days in the rain where you need reliable waterproofing and enough breathability to keep moving — this is the jacket that does that job.

Right now: 20% off, limited stock, offer ends Sunday.

Grab yours before it's gone.
